_comment: SCAIL-2 反抖动配方。关键教训（v28 实证）：SCAIL-2 是动作迁移模型，动作完全由姿态视频驱动，提示词里【不要描述任何动作】——v28 把'挥手'写进共享提示词，导致 idle 段也跟着挥手。提示词只钉三件事：人物外观、场景、稳定性。
prompt: A young man with short black hair and black-framed glasses, wearing a black crew-neck T-shirt, black trousers and a black wristwatch on his left wrist, stands on a night street lined with trees, parked cars and glowing shop signs. His body, shoulders, head and feet remain steady, firm and still throughout the whole video - no shaking, no trembling, no jitter, no sudden position change. The camera is fixed and static. His motions come entirely from the driving pose video. Stable, smooth, high quality video.
